notes:
Everything downloads and renders much faster.

• Graphics render on your GPU — Remotion was rasterizing 4K frames in software while the graphics card sat idle. Renders are 6x+ faster: a 20-second 4K graphic hits the timeline in about a minute instead of 8-10. Machines without a usable GPU path fall back to software automatically.
• Music and SFX land in seconds — big files now download as concurrent segments (a 50 MB track in ~3-4s instead of ~19s). Audition candidates and stems download in parallel, and the Epidemic session is reused instead of re-handshaking before every search.

Speed Ramp
• The ramp is drawn live as a curve, and you can drag its points.
• Custom ramp shapes with draggable tangent handles.
• Click the line to split, and clip lengths that mean something.

Graphics tool
• Export a template's .tsx code, readable fields, and a render queue.
• Graphics AI is cheaper and honest about failures — repeat generate/edit calls reuse the cached prompt (~10x cheaper on retries), and an unreachable or out-of-credits provider now says so instead of "the edit did not return updated component code".
